summary: A four-track FM groovebox firmware modelled closely on the Elektron Digitone, with added engines, drum kits and a performance layer.
features: Engines: 4-op FM, virtual analog, Braids, supersaw, ensemble, drums
4 tracks of 64 steps with p-locks, trig conditions and polymeters
Twelve shared voices across both CPU cores
Chords, scales, arpeggiator and euclidean generator; chains and song mode
USB and TRS MIDI, clock in and out, Bluetooth MIDI host or device
76 factory sounds; projects saved to flash
